title: NC-GH-3: GH-3: Labels, templates, board; roadmap rows as issues
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** the backlog item GH-3 was parked needs-code by the in-tick doer
**Done check:** cmd:python3 scripts/needs_code_bridge.py --probe GH-3
**Status:** closed

GH-3: Labels, templates, board; roadmap rows as issues

Backlog done check: Every row is an issue with owner, trigger and done check

Triage: Creating GitHub issues, labels and templates requires GitHub API access beyond the doer's DB-only permissions. | first step: Add a permitted GitHub-issue-creation step/tool for the doer, then script backlog rows into issues with owner, trigger and done check fields.

Bridged from the backlog by scripts/needs_code_bridge.py (NEEDS-CODE-BRIDGE-1). The change is code, data or a test that a loop consumes; a document alone does not close it.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 26.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
